description: Reference model for an archive, consisting of an organization of people and systems that has accepted the responsibility to preserve information and make it available for a Designated Community

entities.name: Submission Information Package
entities.description: An Information Package that is delivered by the Producer to the OAIS for use in the construction or update of one or more AIPs and/or the associated Descriptive Information
entities.note: SIP is transformed into one or more AIPs during the Ingest process. Governed by a Submission Agreement.

entities.name: Archival Information Package
entities.description: An Information Package, consisting of the Content Information and the associated Preservation Description Information (PDI), which is preserved within an OAIS
entities.note: The core preservation unit in OAIS. An AIP whose Content Information is an Archival Information Collection is called an Archival Information Collection (AIC).

entities.name: Dissemination Information Package
entities.description: The Information Package, derived from one or more AIPs, and sent by Archives to the Consumer in response to a request to the OAIS
entities.note: Derived from one or more AIPs. May contain a subset of an AIP or elements from multiple AIPs.

entities.name: Content Information
entities.description: A set of information that is the original target of preservation or that includes part or all of that information. It is an Information Object composed of its Content Data Object and its Representation Information

entities.name: Content Data Object
entities.description: The Data Object, either physical or digital, which together with its Representation Information comprises the Content Information

entities.name: Representation Information
entities.description: The information that maps a Data Object into more meaningful concepts. It includes Structure Information and Semantic Information, and may recursively reference other Representation Information
entities.note: Can form a Representation Information Network through recursive references to other Representation Information

entities.name: Preservation Description Information
entities.description: The information which is necessary for adequate preservation of the Content Information and which can be categorized as Provenance, Reference, Fixity, Context, and Access Rights Information
entities.note: PDI is associated with Content Information within an AIP. The five PDI categories are all required by the OAIS model.

entities.name: Provenance Information
entities.description: The information that documents the history of the Content Information, including its origin or source, any changes that may have taken place since it was originated, and who has had custody of it since it was originated

entities.name: Context Information
entities.description: The information that documents the relationships of the Content Information to its environment, including why it was created and how it relates to other Content Information objects existing elsewhere

entities.name: Reference Information
entities.description: The information that is used as an identifier for the Content Information. It also includes identifiers that allow outside systems to refer unambiguously to a particular Content Information

entities.name: Fixity Information
entities.description: The information which documents the mechanisms that ensure that the Content Information object has not been altered in an undocumented manner

entities.name: Access Rights Information
entities.description: The information that identifies the access restrictions pertaining to the Content Information, including the legal framework, licensing terms, and access control

entities.name: Packaging Information
entities.description: The information that is used to bind and identify the components of an Information Package. For example, it may be the ISO 9660 volume and directory information used on a CD-ROM to enable finding and accessing the Content Information and PDI

entities.name: Descriptive Information
entities.description: The set of information, consisting primarily of Package Descriptions, which is provided to Data Management to support the finding, ordering, and retrieving of OAIS information holdings by Consumers
entities.note: Used by Data Management functional entity to populate finding aids and catalogs

entities.name: Physical Object
entities.description: An object (such as a moon rock, a ## page document, or a microfiche) that has physicality and can be a Data Object or part of an Information Package

entities.name: Digital Object
entities.description: An object composed of a set of bit sequences. It can be a single file, a collection of files, or a bitstream

entities.name: Structure Information
entities.description: The information that imparts meaning about how other information is organized. For example, it maps bit sequences to common computer types such as characters, numbers, and pixels, and further maps these to more meaningful aggregations such as fields, records, and files

entities.name: Semantic Information
entities.description: The information which further describes the meaning beyond that provided by the Structure Information. For example, the language used to express textual Content Information, what special meaning is associated with certain structures, and expected mathematical operations on array values

entities.name: Submission Agreement
entities.description: The agreement reached between a Producer and the OAIS which specifies a data model, and any other relevant arrangements, for the Data Submission Session
entities.note: Governs the SIP creation and submission process. Defines expected content types, formats, and transfer mechanisms.

entities.name: Event
entities.description: A record of an action or occurrence that affects an Information Package, its components, or the OAIS environment
entities.note: Events form the audit trail for provenance. They record preservation actions, access events, and administrative operations.

entities.name: Agent
entities.description: A person, organization, or software program associated with preservation events and the OAIS environment. Includes Producers, Consumers, and Management roles

entities.name: Transformation
entities.description: A Digital Migration or other process that changes the content, packaging, or representation of an Information Package. Includes Migration, Replication, Repackaging, and Refreshment
entities.note: Transformations are key preservation actions in the OAIS model. Types include: Refreshment (new media copy), Replication (exact copy), Repackaging (new packaging), Migration (new representation).

entities.name: Designated Community
entities.description: An identified group of potential Consumers who should be able to understand a particular set of information. The Designated Community may be composed of multiple user communities
entities.note: The OAIS must understand the Knowledge Base of its Designated Community to ensure information remains independently understandable.

entities.name: Archival Information Collection
entities.description: An Archival Information Package whose Content Information is an aggregation of other Archival Information Packages. Used to manage collections of AIPs as a unit
entities.note: AIC is a special form of AIP used to manage relationships between AIPs and their versions

entities.name: Representation Network
entities.description: The set of Representation Information that fully describes the meaning of a Data Object. Representation Information in digital forms needs additional Representation Information to be understood, forming a network that terminates with Representation Information understood by the Designated Community

functionalEntities.name: Ingest
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions that accept SIPs from Producers (or from internal elements under Administration control), prepare AIPs for storage, and ensure that AIPs and their supporting Descriptive Information become established within the OAIS

functionalEntities.name: Archival Storage
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions used for the storage, maintenance, and retrieval of AIPs, including managing the storage hierarchy, refreshing media, performing error checking, providing disaster recovery, and providing AIPs to Access

functionalEntities.name: Data Management
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for populating, maintaining, and accessing both Descriptive Information which identifies and documents archive holdings and administrative data used to manage the archive

functionalEntities.name: Administration
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for the overall operation of the archive system, including negotiating submission agreements, managing system configuration, auditing submissions, managing archive policies, and providing customer service

functionalEntities.name: Preservation Planning
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions for monitoring the environment of the OAIS, providing recommendations and preservation plans to ensure that the information stored in the OAIS remains accessible to and understandable by the Designated Community over the long term, even if the original computing environment becomes obsolete
functions: Develop Packaging Designs and Migration Plans

functionalEntities.name: Access
functionalEntities.description: Services and functions that support Consumers in determining the existence, description, location, and availability of information stored in the OAIS, and allowing Consumers to request and receive information products (DIPs)

roles.Producer: The role played by those persons or client systems that provide the information to be preserved. This includes the submission of SIPs to the OAIS.
roles.Consumer: The role played by those persons or client systems that interact with OAIS services to find and acquire preserved information of interest. This includes requesting and receiving DIPs.
roles.Management: The role played by those who set overall OAIS policy as one component of a broader policy domain. Management does not include day-to-day archive operations.

packageTypes.SIP: Submission Information Package - delivered by Producer to Archive for ingest
packageTypes.AIP: Archival Information Package - preserved within the Archive, containing Content Information and PDI
packageTypes.DIP: Dissemination Information Package - delivered by Archive to Consumer on request
packageTypes.AIC: Archival Information Collection - AIP containing aggregation of other AIPs

informationObjectTypes.ContentInformation: Content Data Object plus its Representation Information
informationObjectTypes.PDI: Preservation Description Information - five categories supporting long-term preservation
informationObjectTypes.PackagingInformation: Binds and identifies components of an Information Package
informationObjectTypes.DescriptiveInformation: Supports finding, ordering, and retrieving holdings

pdiCategories.Provenance: History of Content Information including origin, changes, and custody
pdiCategories.Context: Relationships of Content Information to its environment
pdiCategories.Fixity: Mechanisms ensuring Content Information is unaltered
pdiCategories.AccessRights: Access restrictions pertaining to Content Information

transformationTypes.Refreshment: Replacing a media instance with a copy on the same or newer media type with no change to the packaging or content
transformationTypes.Replication: Making an exact copy of the AIP on the same or similar media
transformationTypes.Repackaging: Changing the Packaging Information of an AIP without altering the Content Information or PDI
transformationTypes.Migration: Transformation of an AIP involving changes to the Content Information or PDI while preserving the full information content
transformationTypes.Reversal: Undoing a previous migration to return to the original representation

accessLevels.Open: Freely accessible to all members of the Designated Community
accessLevels.Restricted: Access limited to specific authorized users or groups
accessLevels.Embargoed: Access restricted until a specific date after which it becomes Open or Restricted
accessLevels.Closed: No access permitted except for preservation purposes
accessLevels.Conditional: Access granted only upon meeting specific conditions or agreements

eventTypes.Ingest: Submission and acceptance of a SIP into the archive
eventTypes.Validation: Verification of content integrity or format conformance
eventTypes.Migration: Transformation of content to a new format or representation
eventTypes.Replication: Creation of an exact copy for backup or distribution
eventTypes.AccessProvision: Delivery of a DIP to a Consumer
eventTypes.MetadataUpdate: Modification of descriptive or preservation metadata
eventTypes.Deletion: Authorized removal of content from the archive
eventTypes.PolicyUpdate: Change to retention, access, or preservation policies

agentTypes.Software: An automated software agent or system

formatRegistries.PRONOM: PRONOM Technical Registry maintained by The National Archives (UK)
